machine.name: THR00_threat-level-rollup
machine.description: Worst-wins roll-up of the threat observers: THREAT_CONFIRMED if any observer confirms, THREAT_SUSPECTED if any suspects and none confirms, ALL_CLEAR only while every observer is clear. An observation, not a verdict: ai-governance-regime decides (TD-SD-02).
